claim_ceiling: All contexts, forecast ensembles, observations, baselines, decision tolerances and regime labels are synthetic. No empirical forest forecast usefulness limit or AFEX forecast skill is established. A successful receipt verifies only the declared horizon qualification policy and known-truth arithmetic.

policy.forecast_score: empirical CRPS from the shared probabilistic forecast kernel
policy.baseline_rule: preselected frozen baseline, paired by forecast origin and horizon; never selected after observing the evaluation outcome
policy.interval_rule: central 80% nearest-rank interval must lie within the context-declared coverage band
policy.block_rule: all declared held-out evaluation blocks must pass for a horizon to qualify
policy.prefix_rule: useful horizon is the longest initial contiguous passing prefix; later passing horizons cannot reopen a failed prefix
policy.abstention_rule: empty model_samples denotes abstention; it remains in issuance coverage denominator and is not assigned zero CRPS
